comment: Released ADR lines (ADR-0001): per file, the line count released and their SHA-256. Refreshed at release by scripts/adr_lock.py; never edited by hand.

0008-magnitude-scoring-from-clinsig.md.status: - **Status:** Accepted; amended by ADR-0045 (a ClinVar row is capped by ClinVar's aggregate classification of the variant)

0020-cpic-api-allele-function.md.status: - **Status:** Accepted (supersedes ADR-0017 and ADR-0018; superseded as primary filter by ADR-0023)

0021-build-auto-detection.md.status: - **Status:** Superseded in part by ADR-0037 (confidence threshold) and ADR-0044 (the decision rule: evidence from the whole file, contig lengths, no header fallback against contrary evidence)

0023-clinvar-ref-as-primary-pharmgkb-fil.status: - **Status:** Accepted (supersedes ADR-0020's role as primary; reduces ADR-0022's scope)

0024-gwas-magnitude-scoring.md.status: - **Status:** Superseded in part by ADR-0038 (effect-size modifier only)
